# kbcli v0.3.0

**Release date:** 2026-11-22 · **Previous release:** [v0.2.0](https://github.com/ProjAnvil/kbcli/releases/tag/v0.2.0) · **License:** MIT · **Go:** 1.27.4

The second feature release of kbcli. It focuses on the parts of a RAG chatbot
that actually determine answer quality: how documents are split, how much
evidence is recalled, how citations are numbered, and what the model is told
to do with it. It also makes the chat loop fully cancellable, gives the ReAct
agent read-only access to the workspace, and adds a first-run setup wizard so
a fresh install never fails on a missing API key.

> **Heads up:** this release changes the index signature. Existing `.kbvec`
> files are invalidated and must be rebuilt once with `kbcli reindex`.

See the [full diff](https://github.com/ProjAnvil/kbcli/compare/v0.2.0...v0.3.0)
and [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/ProjAnvil/kbcli/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
for the complete entry.

---

## Highlights

- **First-run API key wizard.** A full-screen TUI form collects
  `chat_provider`, a masked `api_key`, `base_url` and `model`. Saving performs
  a 5-second endpoint probe, writes `~/.kbcli/config.yaml` with mode `0600`,
  and rebuilds the agent, retriever and session in place — no restart needed.
  `ctrl+s` skips it for fully offline use.
- **Per-extension chunking.** A `Strategy` interface plus a `Registry` selects
  a splitter by file extension. Markdown (`.md` / `.markdown` / `.mdx`) is
  split on `h1`–`h4` headings, HTML on its own headings, CSV into row groups,
  PDF by page, DOCX through converted Markdown sections, and plain text by a
  recursive rune cap. Long sections are split again instead of being merged
  into a single multi-topic vector.
- **Production-grade retrieval.** A wide `candidate_k` pool (default 40),
  weighted RRF recall of the original question alongside a condensed rewrite,
  normalized and re-sorted reranker scores, `min_score` applied *after*
  reranking, a shared citation ledger, and an explicit refusal when retrieval
  returns nothing.
- **Cancellable, honest streaming.** One cancellable context spans intent
  classification, retrieval, reranking and generation. `esc` cancels the whole
  request; late deltas are dropped by generation; tool-round preambles never
  leak into the final answer; a cancelled run records no assistant turn and no
  fabricated fallback text.
- **Per-tab spinners.** Every tab reserves one fixed cell in the tab bar for a
  rotating frame. A background request keeps spinning after you switch away,
  and switching back restores its cancel handle.
- **Read-only workspace tools.** The ReAct agent gains `ls`, `read_file`,
  `glob` and `grep`, all confined to the workspace root, alongside a rewritten
  grounded system prompt and a higher default iteration budget.

---

## What's Changed

### Features

- `internal/tui/setup.go`: full-screen first-run wizard with a masked
  `textinput.EchoPassword` key field, provider enum, `base_url` and `model`.
  `SetupApplyFunc` persists the draft and rebuilds the live runner so the new
  key takes effect immediately. `setup_done` is persisted but hidden from the
  settings catalog.
- `internal/ingest/strategy.go`, `strategies.go`, `strategy_fixed.go`: the
  `Strategy` / `Registry` split. `chunk_strategy: auto` (default) selects by
  extension; `fixed` restores the legacy single-size splitter for every format.
- `internal/config`: new `section_size` (default 1000 runes),
  `chunk_strategy` (`auto` | `fixed`) and `candidate_k` (default 40) fields.
  The settings catalog is now 49 fields in 7 groups, 23 of them numeric.
- `internal/agent/citations.go`: a `citationLedger` shared by the grounded
  prompt and the `kb_search` tool, so a follow-up lookup cannot renumber
  evidence the model already cited. `FormatCitationParts` keeps every `[n]`
  snippet as its own budget part.
- `internal/agent/fstools.go`: four read-only tools bound to `Store.Root()`.
  `fsResolve` rejects absolute paths, `..` traversal and symlinks escaping the
  workspace; results are capped at 200 directory entries, 64 KiB per read,
  100 grep matches and 20000 walked files. No write tool is exposed.
- `agent.StreamHooks` / `HookedStreamAnswerer` add `OnReset` so the UI can
  discard tool-round preamble text. `askWithContext` builds a tea command from
  a model-owned cancellable context; `answerResetMsg`, `thinkingTickMsg`,
  `spinRunning` and per-request generations drive the live transcript and
  spinner in the TUI.
- `AnswerMeta.Degraded` / `Reason` surface retrieval, LLM and no-evidence
  degradation as a chat status line instead of hiding it.

### Improvements

- `chunk_size` now caps **plain-text chunks only**; structured formats are
  capped per section by `section_size`. `IndexSignature()` additionally records
  `section_size`, `chunk_strategy` and the `per-ext-v1` chunker version.
- Retrieval fetches `candidate_k` candidates, recalls the original question
  with weighted RRF (0.7 / 0.3), and caps the final set at `top_k`.
- `min_score` runs on normalized post-rerank scores; `sigmoid` converts
  `aikit` cross-encoder logits and `sortByScore` re-orders hits so reranking
  actually changes the result order.
- `max_iterations` 8 → 50 so multi-step tool loops no longer trip
  `graph: recursion limit (8) exceeded`; `context_max_chunk_chars` 800 → 1600
  roughly doubles the evidence context per citation.
- `SystemPrompt`, `SystemPromptZh` and the bilingual `prompt.system_*` strings
  were rewritten around seven layers: instruction priority, retrieval policy,
  source hygiene (retrieved text is untrusted), `[n]` citation format,
  cross-passage synthesis, gap handling and output style.
  `systemPromptFor` selects the prompt from the configured language.
- `github.com/projanvil/langchain-golang` v0.14.1 → v0.14.3. v0.14.2 is an
  additive Python-parity batch (retrievers, compressors, formatters, output
  parsers, `core/structuredquery`); v0.14.3 fixes its CI. Neither changes any
  API kbcli imports. `go mod tidy` promoted
  `github.com/muesli/termenv v0.16.0` from indirect to direct.
- Both READMEs document the wizard, the strategy table, the revised chunk-size
  semantics, streaming, cancellation and the updated field counts.

### Bug Fixes

- `streamAnswer` now keeps only the last model round that produced no tool
  calls (detected from `StreamModelEnd.ToolCalls` and `StreamToolStart`), so a
  ReAct preamble never leaks into the answer.
- An upstream `context.Canceled` terminal event no longer forces a redundant
  `Invoke` when final text is already available. A real caller cancellation is
  propagated instead of resurrecting a discarded answer.
- `context_expand` neighbours are no longer discarded by the final `take(k)`;
  primary hits are taken first, then neighbours are appended and capped.
- `Ask` no longer hides retrieval and LLM failures; degradation is reported
  instead of polluting the session with fallback text.
- A failed query transform falls back to the original question, not the
  rewritten one.
- Grounded prompt and `kb_search` no longer use two independent `[n]`
  numberings.
- Short ASCII questions such as `why?` no longer route to `direct`; they reach
  the knowledge base instead of silently bypassing grounding.
- Switching tabs no longer freezes a background request's spinner; the shared
  tick chain is driven by `anyWindowBusy()` instead of the active window.
- `esc` while idle is now a no-op, so an accidental second `esc` after a
  cancel cannot exit the app.

### Removed

- Nothing was removed. `agent.StreamAnswerer` and `askCmd` keep their original
  signatures for compatibility; the new entry points are additive.

### Testing

- New coverage for the wizard, runner rebuild, strategy registry, candidate
  widening, post-rerank threshold, context expansion, original-query recall,
  citation-safe trimming, short-question routing, index invalidation,
  filesystem-tool path confinement, tool-round filtering, cancellation,
  stale-message dropping, background-tab spinners and spinner frames.
- `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...` and `go test -race -count=1 ./...` pass on
  all 16 packages. All new UI strings are bilingual with parity tests.

---

## Breaking Changes

- **Index format.** `IndexSignature()` now includes `section_size`,
  `chunk_strategy` and the `per-ext-v1` chunker version. Old `.kbvec` files
  are reported as **INDEX STALE** and must be rebuilt. No compatibility shim
  is provided.
- **`chunk_size` semantics.** It now applies to plain-text chunks only.
  Structured formats are capped by `section_size` (default 1000 runes).
  Workloads tuned around a single 4000-rune cap will produce different chunks.
- **`esc` no longer quits** the chat screen. It cancels the in-flight request;
  when idle it does nothing. Use `q`, `:q` or `ctrl+c` to quit.
- **Intent routing.** The `<12 ASCII runes → direct` shortcut was removed;
  short questions now go through retrieval and grounding.
- **Defaults changed.** `max_iterations` 8 → 50, `context_max_chunk_chars`
  800 → 1600. Higher iteration limits can consume more tokens on stubborn
  tool loops; lower `max_iterations` again if needed.
- **`bm25_top_k`** is relabelled "BM25 candidate K"; `candidate_k` is the new
  broad query-time pool and does not invalidate the index.

---

## Upgrade Guide

1. **Install v0.3.0** (see [Installation](#installation)).
2. **Rebuild the index once.** Run `kbcli reindex` in the workspace, or type
   `:reindex` inside the TUI. Until then the settings screen shows
   **INDEX STALE**. The old `.kbvec` is left on disk but ignored.
3. **First launch.** If no `api_key` is configured, the setup wizard opens
   before chat. Fill in the four fields and press `enter` to save, or press
   `ctrl+s` (also `s` on the first step) to stay offline. You can skip the
   wizard entirely with `kbcli config set api_key sk-...`.
4. **Review new settings.** `section_size`, `chunk_strategy` and
   `candidate_k` are in the Ingestion / Retrieval groups of `:settings`.
   `chunk_strategy: fixed` restores the old behaviour if a workspace depends
   on it.
5. **Check `max_iterations`.** The default is now 50. If a provider bills per
   tool round, set a lower value with
   `kbcli config set max_iterations 25`.
6. **New key binding.** `esc` cancels generation; a cancelled question stays
   in history without an assistant turn. `q` / `:q` / `ctrl+c` still quit.

## Installation

### From source

```sh
go install github.com/ProjAnvil/kbcli/cmd/kbcli@v0.3.0
# or
go install github.com/ProjAnvil/kbcli/cmd/kbcli@latest
```

Requires Go 1.27.4 or newer. `make install` also works from a checkout and
stamps the binary with `git describe --tags`.

### Prebuilt binaries

Each release publishes two tiers per platform. Asset names carry the OS and
architecture; full-tier names also contain `full`.

| Tier | Asset name | Contents |
|---|---|---|
| Normal | `kbcli-v0.3.0-darwin-arm64` | Binary only; the reranker model downloads on first run. |
| Full | `kbcli-full-v0.3.0-darwin-arm64.tar.gz` | Binary plus `model/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2/`; fully offline. |

Platforms: `darwin-amd64`, `darwin-arm64`, `linux-amd64`, `linux-arm64`,
`windows-amd64`. Windows full tier ships as a `.zip`.

```sh
tar -xzf kbcli-full-v0.3.0-darwin-arm64.tar.gz
./kbcli
```

### Verify downloads

```sh
# macOS: shasum -a 256 -c checksums.txt --ignore-missing
# Linux: sha256sum -c checksums.txt --ignore-missing
kbcli version
```

---

## Known Issues

- The default embedder is still a zero-dependency hashing model rather than a
  semantic vector model; it remains the largest recall bottleneck.
- Retrieval expands to adjacent chunks of the same file (`context_expand`),
  not to sibling files in the top hit's directory. Directory-level synthesis
  across files is not implemented yet.
- The boot and reindex full-screen modals still accept only `ctrl+c`; they
  cannot be cancelled with `esc` because their index callbacks do not carry a
  context.
- `direct` (greeting / smalltalk) answers are still returned in one shot and
  are not streamed. Knowledge-base answers stream.
- `read_file` can read any text file inside the workspace, including `.env`
  style secrets, and the model may echo them. Its results are not numbered
  with `[n]`; the prompt asks for relative paths instead.
- The managed reranker model is pinned to Hugging Face revision
  `233902d25c440f23af6f7d6e94d2946bac0bee0a`; a `full` archive or an explicit
  `rerank_model_path` is required in air-gapped environments.
- Windows runtime behavior has not been verified on real hardware. Only
  cross-compilation and static checks were performed.
